nodes.Name: parser
nodes.DocComment: The parser structure holds the parser's internal state.

nodes.Name: scannerMode
nodes.DocComment: scannerMode returns the scanner mode bits given the parser's mode bits.

nodes.Name: unresolved
nodes.DocComment:
The unresolved object is a sentinel to mark identifiers that have been added
to the list of unresolved identifiers. The sentinel is only used for verifying
internal consistency.

nodes.Name: un
nodes.DocComment: Usage pattern: defer un(trace(p, "..."));

nodes.Name: next0
nodes.DocComment: Advance to the next token.

nodes.Name: consumeComment
nodes.DocComment: Consume a comment and return it and the line on which it ends.

nodes.Name: consumeCommentGroup
nodes.DocComment:
Consume a group of adjacent comments, add it to the parser's
comments list, and return it together with the line at which
the last comment in the group ends. An empty line or non-comment
token terminates a comment group.

nodes.Name: next
nodes.DocComment:
Advance to the next non-comment token. In the process, collect
any comment groups encountered, and remember the last lead and
line comments.

A lead comment is a comment group that starts and ends in a
line without any other tokens and that is followed by a non-comment
token on the line immediately after the comment group.

A line comment is a comment group that follows a non-comment
token on the same line, and that has no tokens after it on the line
where it ends.

Lead and line comments may be considered documentation that is
stored in the AST.

nodes.Name: parseExprList

Children.RawSource: p.tok == token.IDENT || p.tok == token.MUL || p.tok == token.LPAREN

nodes.Name: tryIdentOrType
nodes.DocComment: If the result is an identifier, it is not resolved.

Children.Name: for
Children.RawSource: p.tok != token.CASE && p.tok != token.DEFAULT && p.tok != token.RBRACE && p.tok != token.EOF

nodes.Name: parseOperand
nodes.DocComment:
parseOperand may return an expression or a raw type (incl. array
types of the form [...]T. Callers must verify the result.
If lhs is set and the result is an identifier, it is not resolved.

nodes.Name: checkExpr
nodes.DocComment: checkExpr checks that x is an expression (and not a type).

nodes.Name: isTypeName
nodes.DocComment: isTypeName reports whether x is a (qualified) TypeName.

nodes.Name: isLiteralType
nodes.DocComment: isLiteralType reports whether x is a legal composite literal type.

nodes.Name: deref
nodes.DocComment: If x is of the form *T, deref returns T, otherwise it returns x.

nodes.Name: checkExprOrType
nodes.DocComment:
checkExprOrType checks that x is an expression or a type
(and not a raw type such as [...]T).
